BattTimer 1.0 — Install
=======================

1. Drag BattTimer.app into Applications.
2. Open it from Applications.

If macOS says the developer cannot be verified:
  • Right-click (Control-click) BattTimer.app → Open
  • Click Open again in the dialog
  or allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

Allow Notifications when prompted on first launch.

Requires macOS 13.0+ (Apple Silicon or Intel).

Note: This build is ad-hoc signed (no Apple Developer ID),
so Gatekeeper will warn on first open — that is expected.
